title: Dashboard Spec v0.1
description: Declarative, headless dashboard IR (sprint-113 Phase-2, envelope Option C). Composes bare viz.render chart specs as panels + layout + cross-filter links + KPI tiles — the fixed 'metric overview' template (KPI row + trend + breakdown + optional geo). Chart-level specs (viz.render) are UNCHANGED; this IR sits ABOVE them.
$comment: FROZEN SEAMS — mission-start audit (s113-m01, Rule 1). These 5 integration seams are frozen NOW so m02/m03/m04 add code, not schema churn. (a) CROSS-PANEL DATA-SHARING: shared dataset-level rows at `datasets[]`; panels reference a dataset by `datasetId` + field refs in `encodings` — NOT inline-rows-per-panel, which bloats payload AND blocks cross-filter (tabular panels must share a dimensional space). Non-tabular branches (hierarchy/sankey/network/geo) are structurally distinct and carried inline on the panel. (b) PARTIAL-PANEL ERROR policy: `onPanelError` default 'placeholder' — render an a11y-described error panel in-place, don't void the whole dashboard. (c) CROSS-SOURCE LINK combination: `crossFilter` default { combine:'and', ignoreSelfSource:true } — each active source ANDs a predicate; a panel ignores its OWN source selection; per-link override via `links[].combine`. (d) DASHBOARD-LEVEL A11Y: `a11y` (required) carries a cross-panel summary + `readingOrder` default 'kpi-first' (KPI row read/focused before charts); the per-chart AccessibilitySpec stays per-panel. (e) TOKEN strategy: one dashboard-level `tokenCssRef` (deferred to the consumer CSS bundle per viz.render's compact/tokenCssRef posture); KPI threshold metadata is SEMANTIC only (`threshold.direction`/`value`) — colors do NOT resolve inline. ALSO frozen in m01 (as hand-authored TS, not this schema, since they are runtime interaction state not declarative config): the Selection / SelectionState types in packages/viz-core/src/spec/dashboard-selection.ts, so m03 (cross-filter resolver) and m04 (linked-selection reducer) depend ONLY on m01. The links predicate vocabulary reuses the SectionFilter operator grammar (==|!=|in|not_in|>|>=|<|<=). DEFERRED: brush/interval RANGE selections (point/categorical only v1); anomaly narration (threshold/outlier flag only); the general composer (fixed template first). DOWNSTREAM CONTRACT CLARIFICATIONS (frozen so m02-m05 add code, not schema): (i) KPI TIME AXIS — by DEFAULT (no periodField) the KPI sparkline, comparison.basis 'window'/'prior_period', and aggregate 'latest' ALL read DATASET ROW ORDER as the time axis (rows arrive pre-ordered from the producer). The v0.2 opt-in EXPLICIT period axis is now frozen at (v) below (sprint-114, the #770/#767/#458 churn point); periodField-ABSENT keeps this EXACT row-order behaviour for the sparkline/bases/'latest', EXCEPT the KPI trendDirection, which is reported 'flat' unless a comparison baseline resolves (sprint-149 F6b — a first-vs-last read of arbitrary row order is not a real trend). (ii) CROSS-FILTER SOURCE DIMENSION — DashboardLink.sourceField defaults to the source panel's primary dimension = a TABULAR panel's encodings.x field; a non-tabular source panel (hierarchy/sankey/network/geo) has no encodings block and MUST set links[].sourceField explicitly, else it is not a valid v1 cross-filter source. (iii) SELECTION VALUES — cross-filter Selection.values are string|number ONLY in v1 (boolean dimensions out of scope), so the m04 canonical-ordering normalizer never sorts a boolean. (iv) VENDORED COPY — packages/viz-core/src/spec/dashboard-spec.schema.json is a hand-synced byte-identical copy of this source (the validator inlines it); a viz-core parity test asserts identity, but re-copy on every edit and keep it in the s113 closeout gate sweep. (v) KPI EXPLICIT PERIOD-AXIS (v0.2 additive, sprint-114 — the #770/#767/#458 churn point, FROZEN before compute per Rule 1). KpiPanel.periodField (NEW, optional string) names a time column; when PRESENT, computeKpi builds the metric series along a PARSED + SORTED period axis via the existing UTC-pinned analysis/temporal.ts (parseTemporalValue -> unitIndexFor), instead of dataset row order. FROZEN SEMANTICS: (1) GRANULARITY — per KPI series, pick the FINEST granularity present across the parsed period cells (the summarizeTemporal GRANULARITY_RANK scan), then key every row via unitIndexFor(parsed, finest); mixed-granularity cells coerce to the finest. (2) BASES under an explicit period — 'latest' = the MAX period; 'prior_period' = the aggregate over the series EXCLUDING the single most-recent DISTINCT period; 'window' = EXCLUDING the last N DISTINCT periods (NOT last-N-rows). (3) GAP/DUPLICATE/UNPARSEABLE — sort ASC by the period key; DROP rows whose period cell is unparseable (mirrors numericSeries dropping non-numerics); DUPLICATE periods keep ALL their rows in stable order (NO collapse/roll-up in v1). (4) ADDITIVITY — periodField ABSENT => row-order for the series/bases (existing KPI goldens do NOT re-bake); the KPI trendDirection is 'flat' unless a comparison baseline resolves (sprint-149 F6b); schemaVersion STAYS const 'v0.1' (periodField is strictly optional+additive — no discriminant bump). (5) KpiComparison.field is NOT the prior-period key: it stays RESERVED (a future sibling-baseline column name), unread in v1. (6) a11y wording is GATED on periodField presence (the upgraded '... vs prior period' / '... over the last N periods' basis-naming applies ONLY when periodField is set; absent keeps the exact current string). m03 ADDS exports for unitIndexFor + ParsedTemporal from temporal.ts (currently module-private — additive, behaviour-unchanged). (vi) KPI MEASURE REFERENCE (sprint-116 Phase-3 beachhead, additive — the periodField precedent at (v)). KpiPanel.measureRef (NEW, optional bare string) is a governed-measure provenance/identity key. It is INERT in v1: UNREAD by computeKpi and NEVER echoed to output — field + aggregate remain the authoritative compute inputs, so an ABSENT or PRESENT measureRef yields byte-identical output (no golden re-bake) and schemaVersion STAYS const 'v0.1' (no discriminant bump, exactly like periodField). Validation is STRING-ONLY this sprint (no registry/enum/$ref/resolver, and never an inline {name,field,aggregate,role} object — that would drift against the authoritative field/aggregate inputs). The governed-measure REGISTRY and the mcp-server RESOLVER that would expand measureRef -> field + aggregate at the spec-ingestion boundary (keeping viz-core compute catalog-free) are authorized in SHAPE but DEFERRED to a subsequent gated sprint; the unresolved-ref policy (hard-error) is decided there. The inert-reserved-field precedent is KpiComparison.field ('RESERVED … Unread in v1'). NON-GOALS (held for a later sprint, NOT this one): the general composer / template registry / role binding; the Option-B UiSchema projection; brush/interval RANGE selections; the #428 data-aware suggestion; geo __registration dedup (#774); duplicate-period roll-up/aggregation; timezone/calendar-aware prior_period beyond temporal.ts UTC + last-N-distinct-periods.

schemaVersion.description: IR version discriminant (V01 convention). A future template/shape change bumps to v0.2.

id.description: Stable identifier for the dashboard instance.

title.description: Human-friendly dashboard title surfaced in UI + narration.

datasets.description: SEAM (a) cross-panel DATA-SHARING. Shared, named tabular datasets. Tabular chart panels and KPI panels reference one by `datasetId`; sharing a dataset is what makes cross-filter possible (panels filter the same dimensional space).

panels.description: Heterogeneous panels: chart (any of the 11 viz.render chartTypes + its data branch) or kpi tiles.

links.description: Cross-filter wiring: a selection on a source panel filters a target panel. Declared in v1 (schema-frozen) so m04 adds only a reducer, not a schema change.

onPanelError.description: SEAM (b) partial-panel ERROR policy. 'placeholder' = render an a11y-described error panel in-place (default — don't void the dashboard); 'omit' = drop the failed panel from the layout.

tokenCssRef.description: SEAM (e) TOKEN strategy. One dashboard-level deferred token CSS reference (e.g. 'tokens.build'); tokens stay deferred to the consumer CSS bundle (viz.render compact posture). KPI threshold colors are NOT resolved inline.

Dataset.description: A named shared dataset. Panels reference it by id; cross-filter operates over its shared dimensional space.

rows.description: Flat tabular rows (field name -> value), bounded like viz.render.

Panel.description: A dashboard panel: a chart panel (one of the 11 viz.render chartTypes + its data branch) or a kpi tile. Discriminated on `kind`.

ChartPanel.description: A chart panel — a viz.render-shaped descriptor: chartType (the authoritative 11-value enum) + the matching data branch + encodings. Tabular types (bar/line/area/scatter/heatmap) bind a shared dataset via `datasetId` + `encodings`; treemap/sunburst take `hierarchy`; sankey takes `sankey`; force_graph takes `network`; choropleth/bubble_map take `geo`.

description.description: Optional per-panel accessibility description override (flat string, mirrors the viz.render input).

chartType.description: The authoritative viz.render chartType enum (11 values).

datasetId.description: References a top-level dataset by id. Required for the tabular types (bar/line/area/scatter/heatmap).

measureRef.description: OPTIONAL governed-measure reference (sprint-130 m03). When `resolveMeasures` is set, the resolved registry entry's governed context (displayName/unit/format/threshold/comparison) DECORATES this chart panel's a11y narrative as a leading measure finding. NARRATIVE-ONLY: unlike KpiPanel.measureRef it does NOT rewrite the chart's compute inputs (resolveMeasurePanel is KPI-typed); the chart's encodings/data branch are untouched. An UNKNOWN measureRef under resolveMeasures is a hard error (OODS-V130), mirroring the KPI path (governance consistency). Absent or flag-off === byte-identical.

KpiPanel.description: A KPI tile — the only NEW panel primitive (trend/breakdown/geo already ship as chart types). Reserves value/aggregate/comparison/threshold metadata; the actual compute is deferred to m03 (which reduces the cross-filtered dataset rows to a renderer-agnostic payload).

datasetId.description: References a top-level dataset by id.

field.description: The metric field aggregated into the KPI value.

periodField.description: Optional (v0.2, sprint-114) name of the time column. When PRESENT, the KPI metric series is built along a PARSED + SORTED period axis (via the UTC-pinned analysis/temporal.ts) instead of dataset row order: aggregate 'latest' = the max period, the sparkline is period-ordered, and comparison.basis 'window'/'prior_period' slice by DISTINCT periods (not rows). Rows with an unparseable period cell are dropped; duplicate periods keep all rows in stable order. ABSENT keeps the sparkline, aggregate 'latest', and the 'window'/'prior_period' bases on dataset row order (as in v0.1); the KPI trendDirection is reported 'flat' unless a comparison baseline resolves, because a first-vs-last read of arbitrary row order is not a real trend (sprint-149 F6b). See frozen seam (v) in $comment.

measureRef.description: RESERVED (sprint-116, Phase-3 beachhead): an OPTIONAL bare governed-measure reference — a provenance/identity key (e.g. 'gm.revenue'). INERT in v1: UNREAD by computeKpi and NEVER echoed to output; field + aggregate stay the authoritative compute inputs, so an ABSENT or PRESENT measureRef yields byte-identical compute (no golden re-bake) and schemaVersion stays const 'v0.1'. Validation is string-only this sprint — NOT an inline {name,field,aggregate,role} object, and no registry/enum/$ref lookup. Reserved for the governed-measure resolver (measureRef -> field + aggregate at the mcp-server boundary) in a SUBSEQUENT gated sprint. See frozen seam (vi) in $comment.

aggregate.description: Point-in-time aggregate. Adds 'latest' (most recent value by row order, or by the explicit periodField when set) to the viz.render aggregate set, for point-in-time KPIs.

KpiComparison.description: Comparison basis for the KPI delta. stats.ts deriveTrend is first-vs-last only; this reserves prior-period / target / window bases (computation deferred to m03).

field.description: RESERVED (v0.2): a future sibling-baseline column name. NOT the prior_period key — under an explicit KpiPanel.periodField, prior_period/window are derived from the DISTINCT periods of the metric series itself (see frozen seam (v) in $comment). Unread in v1.

value.description: For basis 'target': the explicit target to compare against.

window.description: For basis 'window': the trailing window size.

KpiThreshold.description: Threshold / anomaly metadata. SEMANTIC only (direction/value) — colors do NOT resolve inline (SEAM e: tokens deferred to the consumer CSS bundle). m03 computes the breach/anomaly flag (reusing stats.ts stddev/tukey for the outlier detector).

direction.description: Whether a breach is the value above or below the threshold.

anomaly.description: Optional anomaly detector to flag (Phase-4 narration deferred — flag only).

Encodings.description: Channel -> field bindings for tabular chart panels (mirrors the viz.render encodings shape).

EncodingBinding.description: An encoding binding: a bare field-name string, or an object with the field plus optional aggregate/scale/timeUnit/sort/title.

HierarchyData.description: Hierarchy data for treemap/sunburst panels — discriminated union on 'type' (mirrors the viz.render hierarchy branch).

HierarchyNode.description: A nested-hierarchy node: a name, an optional numeric value, and optional recursive children.

SankeyData.description: Flow data for a sankey panel — nodes plus value-weighted links (mirrors the viz.render sankey branch).

NetworkData.description: Network data for a force_graph panel — nodes plus directed links (mirrors the viz.render network branch). An empty links array is allowed.

GeoData.description: Geo data for choropleth/bubble_map panels — inline geometry + per-type encoding (mirrors the viz.render geo branch). Geometry is supplied INLINE, never fetched.

topojson.description: Inline TopoJSON Topology (converted to a FeatureCollection).

valueField.description: Choropleth: the numeric field colouring each region. Required for choropleth.

longitudeField.description: Bubble map: the longitude field. Required for bubble_map.

latitudeField.description: Bubble map: the latitude field. Required for bubble_map.

DashboardLayout.description: Optional layout hints consumed by the m02 deterministic auto-layout resolver. Absent hints -> declared panel order + KPI-row-first defaults; the resolver emits abstract {x,y,w,h} (renderer-agnostic, the client sizes the canvas).

placements.description: Per-panel grid hints (gridSpan / order). A panel without a placement uses resolver defaults.

gridSpan.description: How many grid columns the panel spans.

DashboardLink.description: A cross-filter link: a selection on the source panel filters the target panel. The predicate vocabulary reuses the SectionFilter operator grammar. m04 adds the reducer; this schema does not change.

source.description: Source panel id (its selection drives the filter).

target.description: Target panel id (filtered by the source selection).

sourceField.description: Dimension the source selection is on (defaults to the source panel's primary dimension).

targetField.description: Field on the target to filter (defaults to sourceField).

operator.description: Predicate operator (SectionFilter grammar). Defaults to 'in' for categorical/point selections.

combine.description: Per-link override of crossFilter.combine (v1 supports 'and' only).

CrossFilterConfig.description: SEAM (c) cross-source LINK combination. Default: each active source ANDs a predicate; a panel ignores its OWN source selection (skip-self). Per-link override via DashboardLink.combine.

combine.description: How predicates from multiple active sources combine (v1: 'and' only).

ignoreSelfSource.description: When true, a panel ignores selections that originated from itself.

DashboardA11ySpec.description: SEAM (d) dashboard-level accessibility: a cross-panel summary + reading/focus order. The per-chart AccessibilitySpec stays per-panel; this is the dashboard envelope.

description.description: Cross-panel screen-reader summary of the whole dashboard.

ariaLabel.description: Short ARIA label applied to the dashboard container.

readingOrder.description: Panel reading/focus order. 'kpi-first' surfaces the KPI row before charts (the metric-overview default); 'declared' uses panel declaration order.
